resources.string: Keep the chosen key held while pressing a shortcut letter briefly or for longer. Release the chosen key to return to typing. With Fn, hold until the vibration; two quick taps still lock Nav. An assigned Shift is reserved for shortcuts; use the other Shift for capitals.
Open apps and actions with a held key and short or long letter presses.

For shortcuts outside text fields, enable the Plektra Launcher / Clicks accessibility service. Nav Mode is separate. If Android blocks activation, allow restricted settings in this app’s Android App info menu first.
Handles explicitly enabled launcher shortcuts and supported Clicks button remapping. Does not retrieve screen content.
